top_posts.text:
The European Union is making cheap online shopping more expensive.

From July 1, 2026, packages worth less than €150 coming into the EU will have a €3 customs charge for each product category in the order, affecting platforms like AliExpress, Temu and Shein.

For example, if you order a shirt, shoes and a bag and they fall into three different categories, you could end up paying €9 in extra charges.

The fee is officially paid by the seller or importer, but the extra costs may be passed on to customers through higher prices.

The EU says the change is meant to deal with the huge number of cheap packages entering Europe,

top_posts.translation_zh:
